==District 2==
{{Infobox election
| party1 = Democratic Party (United States)
| party2 = Republican Party (United States)
}}
===Primary===
====Advanced to general====
* [[Jared Huffman]] (Democratic), incumbent U.S. representative
* Robin Littau (Republican), [[Enterprise Elementary School District|Enterprise Elementary School Board]] trustee
====Eliminated in primary====
* Gregory Burgess (No party preference), caregiver
* Tim Geist (Republican), former researcher
* Nicolette Hahn Niman (No party preference), cattle rancher
* Paul Saulsbury (Republican), mental health professional
* Angelita Valles (Republican), former [[Victorville, CA|Victorville]] city councillor
* Rose Penelope Yee (Democratic), businesswoman and runner-up for the 1st district in [[2024 United States House of Representatives elections in California#District 1|2024]]
====Withdrawn====
* Colby Smart (No party preference), deputy superintendent at the [[Humboldt County, California|Humboldt County]] Office of Education
